basic_profile.bio: I'm a cryptocurrency enthusiast and a philosophy buff living in Berlin, Germany. By day, I work as a software developer focusing on blockchain technology. I love exploring the philosophical works of Nietzsche, and I often indulge in felting as a calming hobby. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings discussing crypto trends and existential philosophy online. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the blockchain industry for over five years. My interest in philosophy is self-taught, stemming from years of reading and online courses. I stay updated with the latest crypto developments through online forums and professional networks.
